statements.t: With competitive tension high at all three near-term sites, and multiple creditworthy parties at the negotiation table, I have every confidence we will sign the right leases for each site, ones that deliver the most attractive returns for our shareholders.”
"Capital we deploy ahead of a lease becomes part of our equity contribution to a project's financing, and we examine opportunities to recycle capital on an ongoing basis.
Our strategy is to advance at the speed our customers require, while signing leases and obtaining project financing on terms that will deliver attractive returns for our shareholders."

As of September 30, Keel's Bitcoin holdings were nominal, and Bitcoin that is mined from operations in Quebec will be sold on a daily basis moving forward, effectively eliminating the Company’s exposure to Bitcoin price movements on treasury holdings.

risks.t: our limited operating history and history of operating losses, which make it difficult to evaluate our business and prospects
our evolving business model and strategy, including our strategic transformation from Bitcoin mining to HPC infrastructure, which may not be successful
our ability to execute leases with customers for our data centers on acceptable terms, within expected timelines, or at all
delays, cost overruns, and other risks associated with the continued development of our existing and planned facilities
intense competition from other digital infrastructure developers and established data center operators, some of which may have greater resources and experience
the potential inadequacy of our insurance coverage to protect against all losses
the capital-intensive nature of constructing HPC data centers and our potential inability to secure financing or attractive financing for such efforts
significant competition for suitable data center sites and regulatory constraints that could adversely impact our development pipeline
our dependence on significant customers for our HPC data centers, and the risk of customer default or failure to make timely payments
the rapidly evolving regulatory landscape surrounding HPC, AI, and Bitcoin mining, which may negatively impact our expansion efforts
our limited remaining revenue sources until our data centers generate revenue
the high volatility of Bitcoin prices, which has significantly affected and will continue to affect the profitability of our remaining Bitcoin mining operations
fraud or failure of Bitcoin exchanges, custodians, and other trading venues that could adversely impact Bitcoin prices and our business
extensive environmental, energy, and climate-related regulation that could result in significant additional costs or liabilities
political uncertainty in the U.S. and internationally, including potential regulatory and policy changes
